library.pt_000:r_5fc8009a10283f8d.text:
President of Takeo General Company. Age 12.
True to his name, he had an honest, straightforward personality, full of mischievous energy and a love of pranks. By day he was an elementary school student in Midorigaoka Elementary School's Class 6-2, and once school let out (though he often had to leave partway through for work) he led a double life as company president.
He lost his father, the previous president, in a workplace accident, and became the new president so the executives who wanted to close the company would not be left out in the cold. He also inherited Trider, his father's keepsake, and took on sole responsibility for the company's future.
Still an age where he wanted nothing more than to play, he often grew fed up with jobs that came in regardless of his own plans and refused to sortie. But in the end he could never abandon someone in trouble, and his warm-hearted nature always sent him rushing out. His courage was exceptional too, and he faced life-threatening battles against Mecha Robots without flinching.
Trider, his father's keepsake and the company's greatest asset, was his pride and joy. Whenever he passed the park where Trider's face peeked out during his walk to school, he always called out, 'Looking good today too!'
He kept fighting Mecha Robots on the Moon and on Mars, and finally succeeded in driving off Zakuron, commander of the Robot Empire. But even after peace returned, his work as president of Takeo General Company naturally continued.

library.pt_000:r_fee437bed0c74d09.text:
Executive Vice President of Takeo General Company. Age 64.
Since the president was an elementary school student, $$柿小路$$ served as the company's public face by virtue of being its elder and by his position. He was also the treasurer, forever working an abacus to track expenses and income.
He once took a night shift part-time job after finishing his company duties just to earn money for his children's presents, and struggled with money both at the company and at home.
He was often seen cycling out to fetch $$ワッ太$$ by bicycle whenever a job request came in, showing up without regard for whether $$ワッ太$$ was in the middle of class or out in the mountains.

library.pt_000:r_faad6f8fa908c2c4.text:
Managing Director and technical officer of Takeo General Company. Age 50.
He knew Trider's structure inside and out, an able mechanic who handled everything from routine maintenance to emergency field repairs.
Stubborn and uncompromising with a craftsman's serious temperament, he often served as the check on the executive vice president, who tended to run a little wild despite being the oldest of the group. His unwavering presence was also important within the company as the one who kept the section chief and the younger staff like $$ワッ太$$ in line.
He was surprisingly quick with words too, and was often seen coaxing a reluctant $$ワッ太$$ into heading out on a job, sometimes appealing to his sense of compassion and sometimes scolding him until he was in the mood to go.
Unlike the executive vice president, he was never blessed with children of his own, and had taken in the orphan Ryusuke as his adopted son.

library.pt_000:r_762ac63151f051e5.text:
Sales section chief of Takeo General Company. Age 25.
A loud, careless, scatterbrained man who had all three qualities of a shallow, easygoing type.
Fond of flash and always saying 'Let's live it up!', he was forever finding excuses - company trips, banquets, anything - to push for a big blowout. Each time, he earned a glare from the executive vice president, who had to scramble to cover the cost.
By title he was supposed to handle contact with clients and develop new business, but at Takeo General Company, where fighting off Mecha Robots had become the main line of work, he was almost never seen doing any job outside of combat. On the rare occasions he did take action, it amounted to little but complaints and failures, leaving a poor impression.
For all his shortcomings, his natural cheerfulness made him the group's mood-maker. Being the closest in age among the company's adult men, he was, to $$ワッ太$$, an inept but likable older brother figure.

library.pt_000:r_da3b33a0f6acb978.text:
Office and accounting staff of Takeo General Company. Age 19.
As the only female employee, she was something of the company's mascot - beautiful, intelligent, cheerful, kind, and a good cook.
Since the executive vice president handled nearly all the accounting himself, her main duties were chores like making tea and answering the phone. Beyond that, though, her responsibilities were extremely wide-ranging, from announcing Trider's launches to preparing light meals aboard the shuttle to standing in for $$ワッ太$$'s parents at school observation days.
$$郁絵$$ always handled things flawlessly, but when she got word that her grandfather had been hospitalized, even she began to make noticeable mistakes. Unable to cover the high hospital costs, she was troubled at heart, yet still put on a brave face so as not to worry everyone else.

library.pt_000:r_44ead4450a866673.text:
Homeroom teacher of Midorigaoka Elementary School's Class 6-2. Age 28.
She kept Class 6-2, full of distinctive students including $$ワッ太$$, well in hand, and was well liked by them in turn.
She understood the delicate position $$ワッ太$$ was in as both president and elementary schooler, and though worried, always kindly sent him off to work.
The teacher of the neighboring class, Mr. Daimon, had taken a liking to her, but she seemed to pay it little mind.

library.pt_000:r_8af3edbe9ec72dcb.text:
Homeroom teacher of Midorigaoka Elementary School's Class 6-1. Age 28.
Noticeably stricter than Ms. $$美重子$$, he did not look kindly on the fact that $$ワッ太$$, an elementary schooler, was also working. In time, though, he came to acknowledge $$ワッ太$$, who ran himself ragged for the sake of the world, other people, and his own employees.
Though he was in charge of the neighboring class, he frequently showed up in $$ワッ太$$'s classroom to lay down the law over $$ワッ太$$'s repeated tardiness and disruptions. It seemed this was also largely because he was head over heels for Ms. $$美重子$$, and wanted to see her and show off his good side.

library.pt_000:r_cade0f7500a291f5.text:
$$ワッ太$$'s classmate and the class idol he adored.
With her cute looks, excellent grades, and good personality, she was popular with boys and girls alike.
$$ワッ太$$'s rival Kenichi was also always eager to catch her attention, but $$かおる$$ herself treated everyone the same without favoritism.
After $$ワッ太$$ won the final battle against the Robot Empire, though, she showed him a warmth she never had before.

library.pt_000:r_23cf424f79dd9416.text:
$$ワッ太$$'s mother. Age 43.
Though she lost her husband in an accident, she raised her three children admirably. She worked as head of the nursery school next to the Takeo household, a formidable mother who made no compromises in housework, her job, or her children's upbringing.
Having known the Takeo General Company staff since her late husband's days as president, she kept up a close relationship with them. Being fellow women, she and $$郁絵$$ in particular were on especially friendly terms.

library.pt_000:r_c22f1172e450faac.text:
$$ワッ太$$'s younger sister. Age 8.
An energetic tomboy, but also a bright, honest girl.
She was the most level-headed member of the Takeo household after $$加代$$, sometimes teaching $$ワッ太$$ table manners before he went off to a party, other times waking him when he overslept and was about to be late.
She never fought in it, but she did once take the controls of Trider.

library.pt_000:r_984b9b791c366e3b.text:
$$ワッ太$$'s younger brother. Age 5.
A quiet boy compared to the overflowing energy of $$ワッ太$$ and his sister $$サチ子$$.
Devoted to his big sister, he was always tagging along wherever $$サチ子$$ went.

library.pt_000:r_a9f255bd1eccd141.text:
Takeo General Company's pet bulldog.
He was seen a number of times running alongside $$柿小路$$'s bicycle.

library.pt_000:r_a6c543848e2758b6.text:
The boy who pilots $$鉄人$$ No. 28. Age 11.
He was entrusted with $$鉄人$$ No. 28, the giant robot developed by his father, Dr. Kaneda, and completed by his father's friend Dr. $$敷島$$.
Already without parents, he now lived in the annex of the $$敷島$$ estate.
Thoroughly serious in nature and possessed of a strong sense of justice, he never let wrongdoing slide, and had the courage to confront villains even unarmed and in the flesh.
He also had a mischievous streak fitting his age, and often showed his boyish side around Makiko, who had been raised almost as his sibling. His boundless curiosity was also what led him to discover $$鉄人$$ hidden away at the $$敷島$$ estate in the first place.

library.pt_000:r_6ecdec25af1fd87b.text:
The boy who pilots $$鉄人$$ No. 28. Age 11.
He was entrusted with $$鉄人$$ No. 28, the giant robot developed by his father, Dr. Kaneda, and completed by his father's friend Dr. $$敷島$$.
Already without parents, he now lived in the annex of the $$敷島$$ estate.
Thoroughly serious in nature and possessed of a strong sense of justice, he never let wrongdoing slide, and had the courage to confront villains even unarmed and in the flesh.
He also had a mischievous streak fitting his age, and often showed his boyish side around Makiko, who had been raised almost as his sibling. His boundless curiosity was also what led him to discover $$鉄人$$ hidden away at the $$敷島$$ estate in the first place.
When $$グーラ$$ was unearthed from the time capsule, $$正太郎$$ was there the moment he awoke, and was the first to reach out a hand, hoping to become his friend. Though he and $$グーラ$$ would later become enemies, in his heart he kept believing $$グーラ$$ would act for the sake of the Earth.
In the end he was forced to face $$グーラ$$, who had chosen to live for his father over the Earth, and was left to defeat him with his own hands at the controls of $$鉄人$$. Afterward, holding the sword $$グーラ$$ left behind, he mourned his friend's death with the words, 'Next time we meet, leave the sword behind.'

library.pt_000:r_f14cc53a44932035.text:
A robot conceived and designed by Dr. Kaneda and completed by Dr. $$敷島$$.
It is operated by rainbow waves transmitted from $$正太郎$$'s Vision Controller, known as the V-Con.
It is equipped with a solar energy amplification system that grants it near-limitless operating time so long as it has sunlight, and an independent linkage system that lets it keep moving even if part of its body is destroyed. It also boasts a top flight speed of Mach 4.02, underwater travel at 40 knots, and a ground speed of up to 300 km/h, and its sensor light with a built-in radar unit lets it operate in darkness as well, making it capable of activity anywhere, including in space.
In keeping with Dr. Kaneda's ideal of a messenger of peace, it carries no dedicated weapons, but the hammer punch, flying kick, and other techniques unleashed by its sturdy super-alloy body are each a lethal blow.
For all its high performance, its one weakness is that it is only as good or bad as its remote control. When villains have seized the V-Con, $$鉄人$$ has carried out acts of destruction under their command.

library.pt_000:r_e2ae21124782dcd1.text:
A robot conceived and designed by Dr. Kaneda and completed by Dr. $$敷島$$.
It is operated by rainbow waves transmitted from $$正太郎$$'s Vision Controller, known as the V-Con.
It is equipped with a solar energy amplification system that grants it near-limitless operating time so long as it has sunlight, and an independent linkage system that lets it keep moving even if part of its body is destroyed. It also boasts a top flight speed of Mach 4.02, underwater travel at 40 knots, and a ground speed of up to 300 km/h, and its sensor light with a built-in radar unit lets it operate in darkness as well, making it capable of activity anywhere, including in space.
In keeping with Dr. Kaneda's ideal of a messenger of peace, it carries no dedicated weapons, but the hammer punch, flying kick, and other techniques unleashed by its sturdy super-alloy body are each a lethal blow.
For all its high performance, its one weakness is that it is only as good or bad as its remote control. When villains have seized the V-Con, $$鉄人$$ has carried out acts of destruction under their command.
In the final battle, it defeated the Space Demon King by fully releasing its solar energy at the cost of itself. $$正太郎$$ was plunged into grief, but before long the V-Con responded again, and $$鉄人$$ returned safely.

library.pt_000:r_c51809db1c711b75.text:
A robot with a will of its own, developed in the X Gang's underground factory.
It was originally meant to have the entire brain of its creator, Dr. Furanken, copied into it, but the copying process was cut short at only one hundred-thousandth complete, leaving it with the intelligence of a three-year-old.
In power and speed it is a match for $$鉄人$$. It can also fire a powerful electromagnetic beam from its eyes that stops any mechanical device.
After the X Gang killed Dr. Furanken, it was entrusted to Dr. $$敷島$$, but when the X Gang's Gangaru disguised himself as Dr. Furanken and gave it orders, it was made to fight $$鉄人$$.
After Gangaru was defeated, it began fighting alongside $$鉄人$$ of its own free will, becoming a reliable ally.

library.pt_000:r_63788866b02edb1b.text:
A robot with a will of its own, developed in the X Gang's underground factory.
It was originally meant to have the entire brain of its creator, Dr. Furanken, copied into it, but the copying process was cut short at only one hundred-thousandth complete, leaving it with the intelligence of a three-year-old.
In power and speed it is a match for $$鉄人$$. It can also fire a powerful electromagnetic beam from its eyes that stops any mechanical device.
After the X Gang killed Dr. Furanken, it was entrusted to Dr. $$敷島$$, but when the X Gang's Gangaru disguised himself as Dr. Furanken and gave it orders, it was made to fight $$鉄人$$.
After Gangaru was defeated, it began fighting alongside $$鉄人$$ of its own free will, becoming a reliable ally.
It later received an education from Dr. $$敷島$$, and showed growth in both its combat style and behavior. When $$鉄人$$ was driven into a corner by $$グーラ$$, it rushed dashingly to the rescue and saved him from the crisis.
It went on to throw itself into further battles, but after being fitted with a hypnosis device, it lost its sense of self and once again became $$鉄人$$'s enemy. The device was destroyed in battle and it came back to its senses, but in trying to make up for its own mistake it fought recklessly, and was ultimately destroyed.

library.pt_000:r_c78267ead7aa9da2.text:
Dr. $$敷島$$'s only daughter. Age 11.
$$正太郎$$'s girlfriend, the same age as him and his childhood friend.
Cheerful and caring, though $$正太郎$$ is actually the more mature of the two, she often acts the part of the big sister.
Her hobby is tennis, and she is extremely lively and proactive. This has occasionally backfired, though, leading her to act without regard for danger and end up taken captive.

library.pt_000:r_9495c430a862d6b2.text:
Dr. $$敷島$$'s only daughter. Age 11.
$$正太郎$$'s girlfriend, the same age as him and his childhood friend.
Cheerful and caring, though $$正太郎$$ is actually the more mature of the two, she often acts the part of the big sister.
Her hobby is tennis, and she is extremely lively and proactive. This has occasionally backfired, though, leading her to act without regard for danger and end up taken captive.
Being of an age to notice such things, she fell quite hard for $$グーラ$$ while he was living with the $$敷島$$ family.

library.pt_000:r_9193b43ea6038738.text:
A world authority on robotics and aerospace engineering.
Strong in his sense of justice and responsibility, he was an admirable man both as a scientist and as a person. He carried on the will of his late friend Dr. Kaneda and completed $$鉄人$$ No. 28.
He went on to maintain $$鉄人$$ and built the servant robot $$０８$$ and the air car Clipper that $$正太郎$$ rode, while also supporting $$正太郎$$ in various ways, from drawing up strategies in battles against villains to seeing through an enemy's weaknesses. He also had the full trust of Inspector $$大塚$$, who always came to him for advice whenever a robot-related crime occurred. His very brilliance, though, also made him a target for enemies on several occasions.
He valued not only his work but also family life, and treated the parentless $$正太郎$$ much like a father would. After being entrusted with Black Ox by Dr. Furanken, he looked after it well too, patiently and carefully teaching it things like how to move its body.
He was also extremely well-connected, and was acquainted with nearly every scientist who appeared over the course of the story.

library.pt_000:r_a35880cf4c261c33.text:
A servant robot developed to support $$鉄人$$.
Its name is read 'Zero-Hachi.'
Its main role is repairing $$鉄人$$, but by swapping cassettes through the slot in its abdomen, it can automatically perform most any task, from standing guard to tending the garden.

library.pt_000:r_081c360d554055fb.text:
Son of the Space Demon King. Known as the Demon Beast Prince.
He had been asleep in a capsule excavated from underground, but was awakened by Dr. $$敷島$$ and his team.
Present at the moment of his awakening, $$正太郎$$ offered his hand and the two became friends. He was also accepted by the $$敷島$$ family, with Makiko in particular falling for him.
One day, however, an experiment probing $$グーラ$$'s memories revealed his true identity as the son of the Space Demon King. $$正太郎$$ and the others tried to keep it from him, but the Space Demon King's voice echoed in his head, and he remembered his own origins.
Though he felt friendship toward $$正太郎$$, he obeyed his father the Space Demon King and fought to claim the Earth.

library.pt_000:r_af94626fa92aaded.text:
Son of the Space Demon King. Known as the Demon Beast Prince.
He had been asleep in a capsule excavated from underground, but was awakened by Dr. $$敷島$$ and his team.
Present at the moment of his awakening, $$正太郎$$ offered his hand and the two became friends. He was also accepted by the $$敷島$$ family, with Makiko in particular falling for him.
One day, however, an experiment probing $$グーラ$$'s memories revealed his true identity as the son of the Space Demon King. $$正太郎$$ and the others tried to keep it from him, but the Space Demon King's voice echoed in his head, and he remembered his own origins.
Though he felt friendship toward $$正太郎$$, he obeyed his father the Space Demon King in the effort to claim the Earth, at times sending his subordinate Demon Generals and at times personally piloting a Space Robo, fighting $$正太郎$$ again and again.
When $$正太郎$$ and his friends finally closed in on the Space Demon King, $$グーラ$$ was talked into a solo sortie by $$ロビー$$'s smooth words. He lost his life after a fierce battle.

library.pt_000:r_ea9df22e0530930d.text:
The demon king who rules the universe.
He was once human, but when his home planet was swallowed by a black hole, his will to live caused him to merge with it, and he survived as this being.
Utterly cold and merciless by nature, he rules the universe through fear and violence.

library.pt_000:r_75eddee67aebb5f8.text:
The demon king who rules the universe.
He was once human, but when his home planet was swallowed by a black hole, his will to live caused him to merge with it, and he survived as this being.
Utterly cold and merciless by nature, he rules the universe through fear and violence. Yet toward his son $$グーラ$$, he sometimes showed the warmer face of a parent.
At first he intended to swallow the Earth in one stroke, but held back after $$グーラ$$ talked him out of it. When $$グーラ$$ then lost his life in the confrontation with $$鉄人$$, though, he burned with rage and unleashed cataclysms upon the Earth.
When $$正太郎$$ and the others plunged into the dark sun at the heart of the black hole, he appeared by converting the power of his convictions into energy, and drove $$鉄人$$ into a corner with overwhelming force.
In the end, he vanished along with the dark sun when $$鉄人$$ released its solar energy.

library.pt_000:r_5c4936ad8b248448.text:
A Demon General under the Space Demon King.
He never wavered from absolute obedience to the Space Demon King and $$グーラ$$, and delivered Earth's surrender ultimatum on $$グーラ$$'s orders.
A capable commander, he issued precise orders to his subordinates from his giant flying saucer during battle.
When $$鉄人$$ came out to intercept him, he deployed Space Robo No. 4 and faced off against it twice.

library.pt_000:r_ce8fc32e08c168a8.text:
A Demon General under the Space Demon King.
He never wavered from absolute obedience to the Space Demon King and $$グーラ$$, and delivered Earth's surrender ultimatum on $$グーラ$$'s orders.
A capable commander, he issued precise orders to his subordinates from his giant flying saucer during battle.
When $$鉄人$$ came out to intercept him, he deployed Space Robo No. 4 and faced off against it twice, but when $$鉄人$$ smashed the Space Robo into his giant flying saucer, he was caught in the blast and met defeat.

library.pt_000:r_71176d61332d99e5.text:
A robotic life form who serves the Space Demon King.
A survivor of a planet the Space Demon King once destroyed, he possesses a brain with an IQ of 631.
Though slight of build at a glance, he shows considerable skill in hand-to-hand combat as well. He also has the ability to teleport, letting him act as an all-around asset in any situation.
After being made $$グーラ$$'s attendant by the Space Demon King's order, he supported him in the role of advisor.

library.pt_000:r_d2a19d898e48aad4.text:
A robotic life form who serves the Space Demon King.
A survivor of a planet the Space Demon King once destroyed, he possesses a brain with an IQ of 631.
Though slight of build at a glance, he shows considerable skill in hand-to-hand combat as well. He also has the ability to teleport, letting him act as an all-around asset in any situation.
After being made $$グーラ$$'s attendant by the Space Demon King's order, he supported him in the role of advisor, all while secretly plotting revenge against the Space Demon King.
In time he skillfully maneuvered $$グーラ$$ into a fatal confrontation with $$鉄人$$, then threw in his lot with $$正太郎$$ and the others. Once he had seen the Space Demon King's downfall to his satisfaction, he vanished by teleportation to parts unknown, unnoticed by anyone.

library.pt_000:r_4779b8aa1705c824.text:
A psychic born on planet Gishin and raised on Earth. His real name is Mars. Age 17.
As a young child, he was sent to Earth from planet Gishin along with the Six God Robos, including Gaia. When he was taken in by the Myojin couple on Earth, he was given the name $$タケル$$.
Until the invasion from planet Gishin began, he served as gunner aboard the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ as a member of the Crusher Team.
A super A-class psychic, he wielded a wide range of powers: telepathy that let him communicate with others at a distance, psychokinesis that let him fire his own hair like needles, precognition to sense danger, and an acceleration ability to move at superhuman speed. These powers proved a great asset not only in direct combat with enemy psychics but also in saving lives.
His formidable powers and the secret of his birth, however, left him isolated from his comrades in the Crusher Team for a time.
He was also seen more than once running off on his own, driven by his sense of responsibility and duty without listening to those around him, but at heart he was honest and kind. Through his battles he awakened to his true calling, and came to fight for the peace not only of Earth but of the whole universe.
Through his reunion with and parting from his real brother Marg, and his confrontation and eventual reconciliation with the hostile psychic $$ロゼ$$, he finally achieved the defeat of Emperor $$ズール$$, who had been reaching his malevolent hand toward Earth.
When $$ズール$$ later returned, $$タケル$$ was tormented by the Devil Ring, which ate away at his life every time he used his psychic powers. But with help from Marg and $$ロゼ$$, he defeated $$ズール$$ once more.
Afterward, he and $$ロゼ$$ joined hands and set off together for the galaxy.

library.pt_000:r_8e1968a00d317603.text:
Captain of the Crusher Team, a special unit under the direct command of Director $$大塚$$. Age 24.
Calm and unshaken at all times, he was deeply trusted by Director $$大塚$$ and his fellow team members. He fully understood the weight of his position as captain, and had an exceptionally strong sense of responsibility.
In the war with planet Gishin, he took charge of combat command in the field, and the Crusher Team fought according to his orders.
He later became commander of Space Station Ceres, broadening the scope of his activities.

library.pt_000:r_61dd02b7de659989.text:
A member of the Crusher Team. Age 17.
Something of a cynic whose blunt words often led to misunderstandings, he was at heart a kind man who cared deeply for his friends.
He served as gunner aboard the $$コスモクラッシャー$$, and was often seen peering through his scope and firing his laser with his catchphrase, 'How impudent!' during battle.
He had seen $$タケル$$ as a rival ever since they shared gunnery duty, and treated him harder than anyone once he learned of $$タケル$$'s origins. But after coming to understand $$タケル$$'s true heart and reconciling with him, he rebuilt their bond of trust.
When $$ズール$$ returned, he tried to sacrifice himself to aid $$タケル$$, but was saved by the Rose Knight.

library.pt_000:r_8d11adf91da93db6.text:
A member of the Crusher Team. Age 16.
Easygoing by nature, but despite his stocky build, his movements are agile, and he has a delicate sensibility.
He serves as pilot of the $$コスモクラッシャー$$, and his skill is considerable. He also has deep knowledge of machinery.
Good-natured and weak to a pretty face, he once gave $$ロゼ$$, disguised for an infiltration mission, a tour of Battle Camp without a shred of suspicion.

library.pt_000:r_f3ccb5965d4a0c6f.text:
The sole woman of the Crusher Team. Age 15.
Though still young enough to be called a girl, she was an expert in communications and information analysis.
Caring by nature, she always looked out for $$タケル$$, who tended to be isolated because of his upbringing, and often stepped in to support him.

library.pt_000:r_2875e8afbcb2e256.text:
A woman warrior tasked with policing the psychics of planet Gishin.
Recognized for her powerful psychic abilities and loyalty to $$ズール$$, she became one of Wahl's direct subordinates.
She was assigned as adjutant to the mind-controlled Marg, but her post doubled as that of his watcher.
After Marg, whom she had regarded only as someone to watch, saved her life, the compassion and kindness she had sealed deep in her heart began to surface. That respite was brief, though, as Marg's death made conflict with $$タケル$$ unavoidable. Yet through their battles she came to know $$タケル$$'s heart, and after experiencing the kindness of his adoptive mother $$静子$$ and reuniting with his sister Rui, she finally resolved to leave $$ズール$$'s side.
From then on, she volunteered to join the Crusher Team, and became a great force in the fight to defeat $$ズール$$.
For a time she returned to planet Gishin, but when $$ズール$$ made his return, she visited Earth to sound the alarm. There, she learned the secret of $$タケル$$'s suffering under the Devil Ring, and continued to worry for him ever since.
In the true final battle with $$ズール$$ on Earth, she confessed her love to a suffering $$タケル$$ and offered up her prayers.
After $$ズール$$ fell, she and $$タケル$$ joined hands and set off together for the galaxy.

library.pt_000:r_3f597475865697de.text:
The youngest member of the Crusher Team. Age 10.
Having lost both her parents to a Gishin attack, she asked to enlist in order to avenge them. She initially joined Battle Camp working in the mess hall, through her connection with $$タケル$$. Later, when the team headed into space, she went so far as to board the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ in place of $$タケル$$, who fought aboard Gaia.
Despite her unfortunate circumstances, her personality was extremely bright and positive. She tended to speak her mind the moment she thought it, which often led to inappropriate remarks, but her natural cheer and likability made her the team's mascot, easing the mood wherever she went.
She later began showing signs of psychic ability of her own.

library.pt_000:r_33f9f717c6c37c90.text:
Director of the Earth Defense Force. Age 42.
He organized the Crusher Team to protect humanity's advance into space and swiftly resolve incidents that occurred there.
Ordinarily mild-mannered, he carried a dignified presence when directing battles or issuing orders to the Crusher Team.
He was an old friend of Dr. Myojin, and one of the few people who knew the secret of $$タケル$$'s birth.

library.pt_000:r_e727642da6781c23.text:
$$タケル$$'s adoptive mother. Age 42.
She possessed a kindness that made no distinctions between people, and a beauty that belied her age.
She supported $$タケル$$, tossed about by a harsh fate, with a mother's love, and her presence had a great influence on his fight.
After losing her husband to a Gishin attack, she moved to Battle Camp through Director $$大塚$$'s arrangement. From then on, she became a mother figure to the entire Crusher Team.

library.pt_000:r_b0da23abc04016c3.text:
$$タケル$$'s identical twin older brother. Age 17.
Separated from his brother soon after birth, he saw his father executed, and even lost his mother at age 10. Upon learning that $$ズール$$ was behind all of it, he resolved on revenge.
Feigning a loss of sanity to get close to $$ズール$$, he resisted him through an information war, telepathically passing the secret of $$ゴッドマーズ$$ and news of attacks from planet Gishin to $$タケル$$.
Eventually, when Wahl and Sagoul exposed his activities, a bomb was planted on him and he was forced into battle against $$タケル$$. Seizing an opening to break free, he finally reunited with $$タケル$$ and succeeded in passing on their memories of their late parents. But just when it seemed the brothers could finally fight side by side, he was captured by $$ズール$$ and placed under mind control. Forced into a fratricidal battle he never wanted, Marg regained his memories after taking a hard blow to the head in the fighting. This time the brothers truly seemed able to join hands, but Marg stepped in front of a combat mecha to stop $$ロゼ$$, who kept attacking, and was struck by its beam.
He closed out his short life at his brother's side, having never been able to fight alongside him to the end. Yet his resolve to fight for the peace of the universe was carried on by $$タケル$$.
When $$ズール$$ returned, Marg kept cheering $$タケル$$ on from the world of the dead. At times he borrowed $$ロゼ$$'s body to become the Rose Knight, offering direct support as well, supporting his beloved brother even in death.

library.pt_000:r_c3e4f5d7214516d4.text:
An AT pilot who belonged to the Melkia Army of the Gilgamesh faction. His rank was sergeant major.
Perhaps because he grew up constantly exposed to the flames of war from an early age, living day after day alongside death, he is extremely taciturn and unsociable, but his skill piloting an AT is outstanding. He also possesses excellent situational judgment and superb physical abilities. He shows what could be called all-around competence in anything related to combat, from gathering parts from scrap to repair an AT to writing a combat program overnight.
He possesses the quality known as an $$異能生存体$$, showing an uncanny run of luck whenever he faces death and a recovery ability roughly three times that of an ordinary person. Selected for the $$レッドショルダー$$ unit on the strength of these abilities, he was afterward placed under the watch of Yoran Pailsen. In the end, though, Pailsen grew fearful of his abnormal power and moved to have his life taken.
After many battles, he took part in the assault on the asteroid Rid near the end of the Hundred Years War. His encounter, during the operation, with the 'Perfect Soldier' found inside a capsule drew him into a fate even more turbulent than before.
He was reunited with the Perfect Soldier, $$フィアナ$$, in the city of Woodo, and a heart that had known nothing but fighting slowly began to change.
After Woodo's collapse, he drifted on to the Kingdom of $$クメン$$ and then the planet Sansa, and his days there were never free of battle. His fight to reclaim $$フィアナ$$ after the $$秘密結社$$ took her, and to protect her, gradually turned into a search for the secret of his own self.
All of this had been orchestrated by Wiseman, the shadow ruler of $$アストラギウス$$, and $$キリコ$$, by virtue of his qualities as an $$異能生存体$$, had been chosen as his successor and put to the test.
Refusing to be controlled, $$キリコ$$ feigned acceptance of the position of successor, closed in on Wiseman where he lay hidden deep in the ruins of Kuent, and shut down all of his functions.
Afterward, dreaming of a world without war, he entered a long sleep together with $$フィアナ$$, only to have his cryogenic sleep broken by a reviver known as a Retriever.

After that, he set off alone without telling anyone where he was going.

library.pt_000:r_ee8207e70f8fc923.text:
The Gilgamesh Army's first Perfect Soldier, or $$ＰＳ$$.
She was created as a soldier of exceptional combat ability with absolute obedience to orders. Her completion required a substance called Dijirium, also used in computer integrated circuits, which is also essential to sustaining her life.
When $$キリコ$$ took part in the assault on the asteroid Rid, she came into contact with him before the process of implanting programming into her brain as a $$ＰＳ$$ had even begun. Because of this, she came to hold a special, unconscious feeling for $$キリコ$$ as 'the first light she saw,' and eventually began acting against her orders.
She went by many names - Perfect Soldier, $$ＰＳ$$, Proto One - but had no name of her own in the human sense. The name '$$フィアナ$$,' which $$キリコ$$ called out on impulse, later became her name.
In $$クメン$$, she finally left the $$秘密結社$$ behind and joined up with $$キリコ$$. From then on, her heart was always with him.
After $$キリコ$$ defeated Wiseman, she realized there was no place for them in the world as it now stood. She and $$キリコ$$ entered a hibernation capsule together, dreaming of a world without war and falling into a long sleep, only to awaken in a way neither of them wanted.

library.pt_000:r_ebb29f0677520d89.text:
A mercenary from the planet Kuent.
Kuent is a planet famous for sending out excellent mercenaries, and $$シャッコ$$ possesses skill worthy of that reputation.
Calm and collected, and sparing with his words beyond what is necessary, what he does say carries weight, earning him respect from those around him. As a mercenary he was also faithful to his contracts, and in Assemble EX-10 he followed even the reckless orders of his worst superior, $$カン・ユー$$.
But he gradually grew disgusted with $$カン・ユー$$'s high-handedness, a man who thought of his subordinates as nothing but pawns to be sacrificed, and once showed a fierce side by hurling him, branded a 'piece of human trash,' down to the lowest level of the palace after $$カン・ユー$$ tried to use $$フィアナ$$ to save his own skin.
After the fall of the Kingdom of $$クメン$$, he had returned to Kuent, but was reunited with $$キリコ$$ when $$キリコ$$ visited the planet. He actively supported him, even guiding him to his home village.
Even after $$キリコ$$ settled things with Wiseman, $$シャッコ$$ continued to lend his help without reserve, including in the fighting against Nieba.

library.pt_000:r_4ad52065feebe6ec.text:
AT platoon commander of Assemble EX-10. His rank was captain.
A petty and cowardly man, he fawned over his superior, Gon Nu, while ordering his subordinates, including $$キリコ$$, around imperiously.
In his eagerness for results, he sank ships of noncombatants and behaved atrociously toward civilians. His judgment was not sound, and his subordinates' trust in him was extremely thin.
Ever since $$キリコ$$ joined EX-10, $$カン・ユー$$ had made him a target of spite over one thing or another.

library.pt_000:r_f582c857e8e4c331.text:
AT platoon commander of Assemble EX-10. His rank was captain.
A petty and cowardly man, he fawned over his superior, Gon Nu, while ordering his subordinates, including $$キリコ$$, around imperiously.
In his eagerness for results, he sank ships of noncombatants and behaved atrociously toward civilians. His judgment was not sound, and his subordinates' trust in him was extremely thin.
Ever since $$キリコ$$ joined EX-10, $$カン・ユー$$ had made him a target of spite over one thing or another.
In the end, when he turned his gun on $$キリコ$$ and the others to save himself, $$シャッコ$$ stopped him, and he was branded a 'piece of human trash' and thrown down to the lowest level of the $$クメン$$ palace.

library.pt_000:r_3113eda502e87de6.text:
A black-market dealer who once worked the shady trade in the city of Woodo.
Perhaps because of his profession, he had a sharp eye for people, immediately scheming to profit off $$キリコ$$'s skill upon seeing it, and his drive to act was outstanding. He always put money first, but was a likable man with a soft spot and a caring streak that kept him from ever being truly heartless.
In $$クメン$$, he became a merchant doing business with mercenaries in the conflict zone, showing his usual skill by procuring arms and ammunition through his own connections, and became a fixture in Assemble EX-10 as well. Soon after $$キリコ$$ arrived in $$クメン$$ and came under suspicion as a spy, it was $$ゴウト$$'s intervention that smoothed things over.
Even after the fall of the Kingdom of $$クメン$$, he was reunited with $$キリコ$$ on the planet Sansa, and was drawn into $$キリコ$$'s journey to uncover the secret of his own self, staying by his side to the very end.

library.pt_000:r_8f10ec354fa5c3e6.text:
A black-market dealer who once made the city of Woodo his base.
Though he dabbled in the shady trade in that ruined city, he always kept a smile on his face.
After crossing over to $$クメン$$, he ran the bar 'Phantom Club.' His easy manner served him well in the hospitality trade, and the bar thrived on business from mercenaries.
A former air force pilot, he was skilled at flying helicopters. After the bar burned down in the fighting, he volunteered as a mercenary and took part in combat as a liaison flying a helicopter.
When he first met $$キリコ$$ in Woodo, he had approached him purely to make money, but he eventually became, along with $$ゴウト$$ and $$ココナ$$, one of $$キリコ$$'s closest friends, and kept supporting him while grumbling about it all the while. He even named the bar the way he did so that $$キリコ$$ would notice it right away.
Through their constant bickering and teasing, he and $$ココナ$$ gradually became important to each other.
Even after the fall of the Kingdom of $$クメン$$, he was reunited with $$キリコ$$ on the planet Sansa, and was drawn into $$キリコ$$'s journey to uncover the secret of his own self, staying by his side to the very end.

library.pt_000:r_7fe26c6d5aa93969.text:
A war orphan who once lived in the city of Woodo.
A tomboy who put on a brave face, though the sorrow of having lost her family to the war occasionally showed through.
Trading barbs all the while, she often acted together with $$ゴウト$$ and $$バニラ$$ as their mismatched trio. Their curious bond continued even after she crossed over to $$クメン$$, and she became the star singer at the bar 'Phantom Club,' which the two men ran together.
After falling for $$キリコ$$ at first sight, she treated him warmly at every turn, though $$キリコ$$ himself paid it no mind at all. Amid all this, she and $$バニラ$$ gradually grew drawn to each other.
Even after the fall of the Kingdom of $$クメン$$, she was reunited with $$キリコ$$ on the planet Sansa. She too was drawn into $$キリコ$$'s journey to uncover the secret of his own self, staying by his side to the very end.

library.pt_000:r_78b7e5332197599a.text:
A soldier in the intelligence division of the Melkia Army, Gilgamesh faction. His rank was captain.
He was tasked with recovering the Perfect Soldier and kept watch over $$キリコ$$'s movements.
Whether his current name is his real one is unknown; he once went by 'Kotta Ruske.' Captivated by Pailsen's power, he changed his name after shooting dead his former superior and Pailsen's rival, Fedok Wokkam.
After leaving the Gilgamesh Army, he became a colonel in the Balarant Army, and appeared before $$キリコ$$ again on the planet Sansa.
His hidden purpose was to obey the orders of his true master, Wiseman, and watch over and guide $$キリコ$$, a candidate to become his successor.
When $$キリコ$$, chosen as the successor, betrayed Wiseman and destroyed his memory device, $$ロッチナ$$ cried out in anger and despair at $$キリコ$$ casting aside, of his own will, the very thing $$ロッチナ$$ himself had sought for so long and never attained.
